message: Hey John, how's everything going with you and Emily? Hope all is well. Dad.
John, I've never told anyone this, but my childhood was really tough after my parents' divorce. I trust you with this.
The trip to the Evergreen Botanical Gardens was amazing! We should definitely go back when the cherry blossoms are blooming. :)
John, are we still on for the basketball game this Friday?
Reminder: Your term paper on 'Cognitive Psychology' is due next Monday.
Can't stop thinking about how peaceful it was at the gardens. It's like we were in a different world away from all the stress.
John, remember to stay focused on your studies. But also take time to enjoy your youth. Dad.
I'm so glad you're in my life, you make everything better. Thanks for being there for me.
Don't forget our meeting tomorrow at 5 PM about the charity event.
Hey, let's plan something special for our 6-month anniversary coming up!
